content: Agent Skills (agentskills.io) SKILL.md spec: required name (1-64 chars, lowercase/digits/hyphens, must equal directory name) and description (1-1024 chars); optional license, compatibility, metadata, allowed-tools. Verified scan paths from official docs: Claude Code .claude/skills only; Cursor .agents/skills, .cursor/skills plus .claude/skills and .codex/skills for compat; GitHub Copilot .github/skills, .claude/skills, .agents/skills; Codex .agents/skills only. Therefore two copies (.claude/skills + .agents/skills) cover all four runtimes.
